name: RecordList
description: A plain list of records of one type, each entry rendered by that record type's own card. The simple counterpart to the Teaser: no Figma layout variants, no slider, just a grid or a compact stack.
when_to_use: When a page needs 'the latest N news posts' or 'all team members' with no styling decisions. Reach for the Teaser instead when the section needs a header row, a specific Figma layout, or hand-picked records in a chosen order.
capabilities: lists records of any active record type — each entry dispatches to that type's card, so a property looks like a property
auto by default (newest first, up to `limit`) or hand-picked via the shared record picker
renders on both data sources: TYPO3 resolves the records server-side, CMS-free mode reads them through the broker

ai.prompt_summary: RecordList (factory_record_list): a list of records of one type. Settings: eyebrow, headline, intro, record_type (from the site's record types), limit (default 6), layout (cards|compact), records (optional CSV of record UIDs — leave empty to list the newest automatically). It renders the records' own cards, so do NOT author card content here; create or edit the RECORDS instead.
ai.content_guidelines: Headline names the collection ('Aktuelles', 'Unser Team'), not a sentence. Leave `records` empty unless the client wants a specific order.
